comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
I believe this item's map is dropped by Wood Poacher Lv41 in the South America Northeast Coast landing point in the Cape San Roque, Open Sea zone. It's female-only and color-customizable.

Note: if I read the blog right, the treasure map may not always drop the dress, so you might do well to collect multiples to be safe. Cheers.

Blog: ayatoayayo.blog.fc2.com/blog-entry-76.html
